places.name: Juneau
places.blurb: Juneau is the capital of Alaska, United States. Alaska's capital is unreachable by road — you can only arrive by boat or plane. It was named for Joe Juneau, a gold prospector who struck it rich here in 1880. It's one of Alaska's biggest places.
